lineage.description: Displacement data collected by IOM using DTM standard methodology following the Ulawun volcano eruption in Papua New Guinea. Site assessments recorded the number of families and individuals displaced, with demographic disaggregation (age and gender) at sub-national administrative levels to document direct population impacts.
